operations.description: Query the 3-float position offset into locals v16/v17/v18: TripleFieldQuery(&v16, &v17, &v18).
Compute the object's local bounding-box extents from the 3-float fields at a1+0x0/0x4/0x8 into locals v13..v15 (min side) and v10..v12 (max side): BoundingBoxComputation(a1, &v13, &v10).
Translate both local extents by the queried offset: v5 = v16 + v13, v14 = v17 + v14, v15 = v18 + v15 (min side) and v10 = v16 + v10, v11 = v17 + v11, v12 = v18 + v12 (max side).
Merge the translated min extents into the running min bound a2 with per-axis minimum: a2[0] = min(a2[0], v5), a2[1] = min(a2[1], v14), a2[2] = min(a2[2], v15).
Merge the translated max extents into the running max bound a3 with per-axis maximum: a3[0] = max(a3[0], v10), a3[1] = max(a3[1], v11), a3[2] = max(a3[2], v12).
Return void; all six bounds are updated in place through a2/a3.
